goal:
Create only src/store.ts, exporting synchronous openStore(dataDir:string):ProjectStore from protected store-contracts.ts. Implement the actual local single-owner project/pack repository for the E2E dashboard/control API, not a mock. Use Node24 built-in node:sqlite DatabaseSync (verified installed), node:crypto randomUUID and builtin fs/path, no new dependencies. Persist in dataDir/e2e.sqlite with schema user_version1, projects table and packs table referencing projects ON DELETE CASCADE; foreign_keys ON, parameterized queries, bounded busy timeout/WAL suitable for a single local owner. Reject unsupported future schema versions rather than silently rewriting them. Create dataDir only after validating nonempty string/no NUL; close database on initialization failure. No exported raw DB handle, no shell/Git/network/browser side effects.
ProjectStore public methods exact from contracts: createProject(input),updateProject(id,input),listProjects(),getProject(id),deleteProject(id),savePack(projectId,input),getPack(projectId),close(). ProjectRecord exact id/name/baseUrl/environment/createdAt/updatedAt. Only input keys name/environment/baseUrl; use existing record/onlyKeys/text and validateTarget with project assigned generated id, production disabled; narrow environment to local|staging. Name trimmed nonempty<=100. UUID id generated by host runtime, UTC ISO dates, canonical URL from validator. update requires existing id and full valid replacement input, preserves id/createdAt/pack and updates updatedAt. Invalid requests must not partially modify DB. list/get return detached typed records, never SQL-specific values; narrow row values correctly without any/unsafe casts. getProject/getPack valid missing UUID=>null, delete missing=>false; malformed ids throw before SQL. update/savePack unknown project throws. Do not echo submitted credentials or raw payloads in validation errors.
SavePack validates full pack via validatePack, project must exactly equal referenced UUID. Upsert one pack per project atomically; persist validated JSON and reconstruct detached Pack on reads. Invalid or cross-project writes preserve previous saved data. Project deletion cascades pack; other projects unaffected. Use prepared SQL bindings, never interpolate user ids/names into SQL. close idempotent; all other methods after close reject. Use small reusable validation/row helpers, avoid duplicated schema validation or cached mutable data. Keep file under16000characters.
Protected tests check real SQLite header, reopen persistence, detached returned data, schema validation/no partial writes, project update identity, cascade delete and SQL-shaped invalid ids. Existing target/pack regressions run too. Tests are examples: implement full contract. No protected edits or new files except store.ts, no unrun test claims. Source delivery after independent review, not merely protected pass. Only selected E2E code/tests/requirements/local metadata to Gemini; no keys/client code/Platform source. Prior phase calls remain spent; task has at most2calls under current12-call approval.
